title: Kubernetes GitOps
description: Checks for desired state, reconciliation and recoverable changes with GitOps controllers.

rules.instruction: Keep desired workload state in the project's reviewed declarative source. Record which controller owns each resource scope and resolve secrets from the approved secret system.
rules.verification: Confirm that the change is traceable to a reviewed source revision. Inspect ownership and secret references for the modified resource scope.

rules.instruction: Review synchronization, drift correction and pruning settings when changing a controller or removing resources from its source.
rules.verification: Inspect the reconciliation preview or events in the approved test environment. Confirm which resources update, stay in place or get removed.

rules.instruction: Document how to restore the prior desired state through the supported source workflow. Record manual recovery steps for stateful changes.
rules.verification: Rehearse a reversible change in the test environment and compare the reconciled state and service health with the recovery plan.
